chart.title: Countries by share of women in parliament
chart.subtitle: Percentage of seats in lower or single chamber of the legislature held by women.
chart.note: Only countries with at least one legislative chamber included.

Number of countries with no women in par.descriptionProcessing: We only count the countries that V-Dem covers in the given year. Where we impute a country's data from a historical entity it was part of, those imputed values are excluded from the count, because the country did not yet exist separately at the time.
